release_rule: saved burst/seed201/B2 CG_DC input +35s; second session last 12 requests additional +25s, arrivals unchanged
preload: whole HAL uptime query brackets after actual baseline start and before first dispatch; >=15 samples, >=55s span, gaps <=10s
prediction_inputs: original frozen beta and state-minus-idle slopes
direction_readout: prediction-minus-observation and fixed endpoint changes; no shifted windows, no endpoint extrapolation, no universal significance threshold
ap_scores: first dispatch to sampled cooling-end coverage; absolute and change-from-start error equivalent with common initial AP; MAE/max/diagnostic peak and phase residuals
energy_scores: exact common 0-120 seconds; original W diagnostic only, no new power fit
missing: null; separate data eligibility from score and accuracy
completion: both attempts finish or first failure ends bundle; fixed readout and no extra session/refit
scope: one independent new session per registered history, same 3d8 APK; protocol transfer from 747-series candidate development; not universal thermal or online policy validation
execution_gate: original battery>=20%, unplugged, BAT<=35C, thermal0, screen and memory and warmup-quality; numeric AP finite/fresh, development 32.5-34.0C range is classification only
